notes: England only (Scotland and Wales are separate queue lines). RCVS Find a Vet: the findavet.rcvs.org.uk page redirects to rcvs.org.uk and could not be fetched (not in the allowed fetch set); the RCVS 'practice data conditions of supply' page says RCVS practice data is supplied to third parties only under conditions, so no RCVS data was used - clinics' own pages only. NO DUTY ROTA found: England has no official duty-rota page (RCVS requires each practice to provide 24-hour emergency cover itself); none added. POISON LINE: Animal PoisonLine 01202 509000 is a paid service (GBP 35 / 45 per case).
